items.statement: The submission identifies the supplied G1GS structure as the isolated G1 cation and reports charge, multiplicity, software/model and geometry provenance.
items.expected: A reproducible isolated-G1 setup with explicit charge +1 and singlet state, or a chemically justified tested alternative, is documented.

items.statement: The workflow validates the optimized ground and excited-state endpoints and tracks the intended S1 state before evaluating emission.
items.expected: Convergence, state identity and Hessian/frequency or equivalent stationary-point evidence are supplied for the reported endpoint.

items.statement: The calculated isolated-G1 S1 emission is close to the paper's reported isolated-guest photoluminescence value.
items.expected: The reported emission wavelength is approximately 540.3 nm, with method/uncertainty context and no conflation with the separate CB[8]G1 host--guest value.

items.statement: The transition analysis supports predominantly intramolecular charge-transfer character for G1 rather than a host--guest donor--acceptor transition.
items.expected: NTO/transition-density evidence locates hole and electron on different regions of the G1 guest and explicitly distinguishes this from host-mediated transfer.
